newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu 6,890 to dlr on March 21 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu 6,890 to dlr on March 21 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday it had calculated the exchange rate of the leu at 6,890 to the dollar for March 21.

The rate, which is not compulsory for book-keeping operations or inter-bank deals, would be used by the Finance Ministry, customs authorities, prosecution and police, as well as for statistical purposes.
The announced rate is based on prices quoted by commercial banks operating on Romania's foreign exchange market.
The BNR calculates the leu's exchange rates on a daily basis, but so far made public it public only once a week.
It will start releasing the leu's exchange rates on a daily basis next Monday, BNR spokesman Mugur Stet told Reuters.
The leu-dollar rates over March 17 to 20 were 6,952, 6,934, 6,910 and 6,903, the BNR said.
Last month, the BNR gave up computing the so-called leu's reference rate which was a weighted average based on daily reports from market operators.
